thread:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — launching a targeted push to recruit design partners for the Private preview (VPC + KMS) next quarter. Need quick alignment on outreach, intake signals, and success criteria.

Maria Lopez: 👍 who should we prioritize — enterprise security teams or mid-market product orgs?

Alex Chen: Primary: security/compliance-first (finance, healthcare). Secondary: platform teams that need predictable latency for multi-tenant apps.

Samir Patel: Intake signals to prioritize: 1) existing Dedicated customers spending > $10k/mo, 2) support tickets requesting on-prem/VPC, 3) inbound RFPs mentioning KMS/HSM. Those show high intent.

Nina Park: Add: customers hitting token/latency limits and teams using long-context LLMs. Tag by model workload (generation vs embeddings).

Maria Lopez: Draft outreach DM? Keep short, value-first, ask for a 4-week pilot commitment, offer infra support + waived infra fees for early partners.

Alex Chen: Draft: 
``
Hi {Name},
Were running a small private preview for Redwood Private (VPC + KMS). Looking for a security-focused partner to pilot for 4 weeks — well provide infra support, a dedicated onboarding engineer, and a credits waiver. Interested in a short sync?
— Alex
```

Samir Patel: Add an optional note about migration help and model pinning — enterprise asks that a lot.

Nina Park: Feedback loop proposal: twice-weekly async check-ins (Slack + short form) and a 30m weekly sync. Require prompt-level evals and performance telemetry ingested to Console for their routes.

Alex Chen: Minimum telemetry/data from partners during pilot: 1) three representative prompt sets, 2) latency & error traces for those routes, 3) a weekly qualitative note on failures/hallucinations.

Maria Lopez: Success criteria suggestions: Functional — Private handles selected routes at <1.5x baseline latency. Security — KMS validated and zero sensitive data egress incidents. Business — partner signs a Dedicated/Private contract or has a clear purchase runway within 90 days.

Samir Patel: Operational criteria: onboarding <10 days to first test traffic; no more than 2 sev-2 issues during pilot.

Nina Park: Scope negotiation rule: deliver core infra + onboarding. Defer custom analytics or feature work to backlog with an explicit timeline and prioritization decision. State this in the kickoff call.

Alex Chen: Intake form fields (minimal): company, contact, deployment target (VPC/on-prem), primary use-case, expected traffic (RPS), KPIs (latency/cost thresholds), and security controls required.

Maria Lopez: Ill create a Typeform + sheet to track. Can we add an automated CRM tag "DP-Private-Pilot" so AEs prioritize leads?

Samir Patel: Sales ops coordinate on tagging. Also propose two pilot tracks: "Fast-turn" (4 weeks, limited routes) and "Deep" (8–12 weeks, broader integration). Different SLAs and credit levels.

Nina Park: For telemetry visibility: ensure Console shows route-level token breakdown and an SLO dashboard. If not ready, commit to weekly exported reports and raw telemetry uploads.

Alex Chen: Risk register highlights: 1) KMS misconfig — mitigate with runbook and pre-check with partner cloud admin; 2) infra cost overruns — cap credits and set clear compute limits; 3) feature creep — gate via product sign-off.

Maria Lopez: Proposed timeline: Week 0 recruit & intake, Week 1 onboarding & security review, Week 2 ramp tests, Weeks 3–4 pilot run, Week 5 debrief & commercial decision.

Samir Patel: Owners per partner: 1 onboarding engineer + 0.25 PM FTE for Fast-turn. Need named owners in intake.

Alex Chen: I can allocate Emma Li as onboarding engineer and Nina Park as PM for initial partners.

Nina Park: Ill make a Confluence pilot checklist and link it to the intake form.

Maria Lopez: Next actions: Maria to build Typeform + sheet by EOD Thu, Samir to set CRM tag, Alex to finalize outreach DM and seed targeted list, Nina to draft Confluence checklist.

Alex Chen: Ill start outreach to 6 high-intent customers this week. Ping in-thread with blockers. 🚀
